parameters.formDescription: Scanned the QR? The id is already filled in. Photograph the sample as it arrived, before you open anything.

nodes.name: Settings B
nodes.notes: Everything an operator changes lives here. Spreadsheet id and chat id are the two that must.

nodes.name: Normalise receipt form
nodes.notes: The id is uppercased and trimmed here, because it gets typed by hand whenever a QR will not scan.

nodes.name: Find the sample
nodes.notes: Always answers, so an unknown id reaches the guard instead of ending the run silently.

nodes.name: Can log arrival?
nodes.notes: One place answers whether a status may move. No node gets to skip the question.

nodes.name: Compute SLA
nodes.notes: Starts the only clock in the workflow. Everything the chase run does depends on this timestamp.

nodes.name: Build arrival update
nodes.notes: Only the columns arrival is allowed to write, plus the id the update matches on.

nodes.name: Record the arrival
nodes.notes: Matches on sample_id. A partial row on purpose.

value.row: ={{ JSON.stringify({ "ts": $('Compute SLA').first().json.receipt_ts, "sample_id": $('Can log arrival?').first().json.sample_id, "actor": "arrival form", "action": "received", "from_status": $('Can log arrival?').first().json.from_status, "to_status": "received", "note": $('Normalise receipt form').first().json.receipt_condition + ($('Normalise receipt form').first().json.notes ? ': ' + $('Normalise receipt form').first().json.notes : '') }) }}

nodes.name: Compose arrival notice
nodes.notes: The message the grader replies to. The sample id in this text is the entire binding mechanism.

nodes.name: Ask for the assessment
nodes.notes: Do not remove the sample id from this message. Evaluation reads it back out of the reply.

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ 'Arrival recorded as ' + $('Normalise receipt form').first().json.receipt_condition + '.\n\n' + 'The grader has been asked for an assessment. Due ' + $('Compute SLA').first().json.sla_due_ts.slice(0, 10) + '.' }}

parameters.text: ={{ $('Can log arrival?').first().json.sample_id + ': ' + $('Can log arrival?').first().json.reason + '. Nothing was written.' }}

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ $('Can log arrival?').first().json.reason + '.\n\nNothing was written. If this is wrong, check the id on the label against the register.' }}

parameters.content:
## Flow B: Receipt

The QR opens this with the id already filled in. The clock starts here.

**Do not remove the sample id from the message this sends.** The grader replies to it, and that reply is what binds an assessment to a sample. No session state, no commands.
